newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian soldier killed in U.S. wargames.
newsitem.headline: Australian soldier killed in U.S. wargames.

text.p: An Australian army officer was killed early on Thursday during joint Australian-U.S. wargames in the northern state of Queensland, military authorities said.
"The man was apparently injured in an accident involving an armoured personnel carrier in which he was riding," the Defence Department said in a statement.
"Prompt medical attention was administered, but he died three hours later."
The accident occurred at 1.30 a.m (1530 GMT Wednesday) and radio reports said the accident involved the vehicle's hatch.
The man's name and rank were not released.

Almost 27,000 military personnel and more than 200 warships from both countries are taking part in the Tandem Thrust wargames, the biggest joint operation between Australia and the United States since World War Two.
The death is the first in the almost two-week long operation, which is due to end on Saturday.
